name: What steps can I take to prevent mold in my commercial property?

mainEntity.name: What steps can I take to prevent mold in my commercial property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing mold in commercial properties primarily involves controlling moisture. Regularly inspect for and promptly repair any leaks from pipes, roofs, or windows. Ensure proper ventilation in areas like restrooms, kitchens, and basements. Maintain indoor humidity levels below 60% using dehumidifiers if necessary. Clean up any spills or water intrusions immediately and thoroughly dry affected areas. Proper maintenance of HVAC systems, including timely filter changes, also helps circulate dry, clean air and prevents condensation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold by controlling moisture: fix leaks promptly, ensure good ventilation, maintain low humidity, and quickly dry any water intrusions.
